title: Battle of Carillon
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Carillon", at revision 1380652065, opens: "The Battle of Carillon, also known as the Battle of Ticonderoga, was fought on July 8, 1758, during the French and Indian War. It was fought near Fort Carillon on the shore of Lake Champlain in the frontier area between the British colony of New York and the French colony of New France." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q697897, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1758 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
